_model: XRAP -- Fiori, Chakraborty & Nikitina (2022) data-optimized shortwave-fadeout absorption
_form: A(f0) = scale * flux^flux_exponent * g(chi)^cos_exponent   [dB, one-way, at f0 MHz]; A(f) = (f0/f)^freq_exponent * A(f0) (saturating below freq_saturation_mhz, see _saturation); A >= 0.  flux = GOES 0.1-0.8 nm (W/m^2).  g(chi) = cos(chi) (hard, 0 for chi>=90) or 1/Ch(chi) (grazing).
_saturation: Low-frequency saturation: A(f) = (f0/f)^n * A(f0) for f >= freq_saturation_mhz; below it A(f) = 2 f0^n / (f^n + fs^n) * A(f0) (continuous at fs, bounded by 2 (f0/fs)^n as f -> 0). Physical idea: D-region collisions dominate at low f, so absorption stops depending on f. null disables.
